name.ja: レーナのキノコスープ

requirement.en: You have a face-up DARK Attribute Warrior Type monster on your field.

effect.en: Choose 1 face-up monster on the field. While that monster is face-up, it loses 700 ATK. If you chose a "Doomed by the Blackblight" on your field by this effect, you can Ritual Summon a Level 1 DARK Attribute Warrior Type monster by sending the chosen monster to the Graveyard as material.
